title: Lasted 14 days
text:
Lasted 14 days. I had a cup of tea tonight and found that some tea had found its way between the walls. Well that was a kick in head. Never went in dishwasher. Hand washed. Looks like there is a minute hole in bottom of outer layer.
A shame, as it was really fine when first used.
